intent: In-place melee combo composed of two consecutive strikes: overhead anticipation/wind-up → first strike → recoil/reload → second strike opening laterally → recovery to the initial stance.

phases.description: Anticipation: from the initial stance, both hands gather and rise into an overhead wind-up.
First strike: both hands sweep down from overhead and across the body.
Recoil/reload: the torso moves back/leans and lowers toward the f73 region before reloading.
Second strike: the torso rotates open and the arms extend laterally toward a wide extension.
Recovery: follow-through, then the torso and arms return near the f0 stance to close the loop.

keyPoses.description: Hips Z reaches an approximate minimum of -0.233.

weightTransfer: The pelvis is used as a proxy for weight transfer. During the first strike, the pelvis shifts strongly along +X from f46 (X=-0.468) to f56 (X=+0.413). During the second strike, the pelvis moves from f79 (X=+0.123, Y=+0.104) to f94 (X=-0.110, Y=-0.177), reversing toward -X and advancing forward along the canonical -Y axis. No support/planted foot is assigned.
bodyMechanics: During the second strike, hips/chest rotation increases strongly at f84; distal movement of the right hand peaks later at f89-f91; the right shoulder continues follow-through to f93. The observed coordination is core rotation → right-hand/arm extension → shoulder follow-through.

recommended: anticipation → strike → recoil/reload → second strike → recovery

notes: An exact impact/contact frame is not identified because preview.gif has no target/contact event.
No support/planted foot is assigned because the source does not provide sufficient contact/force event evidence to determine the support side.
